accessPolicy.note: NLM invites API use and says no license is generally needed, but RxClass combines multiple independently governed relation sources. SNOMED CT requires its affiliate license; WHO ATC, DailyMed, MED-RT, FDASPL, VA, and other relations require source-specific treatment. A source-global permission would be too broad.
